The petitioner is present in court today who has been identified by the Investigating Officer,
Inspector Yuvraj Prasad.
7. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the condition of the petitioner's father is serious and is suffering from chronic kidney disease and has been referred to RML Hospital.

8. The learned APP on instructions from the Investigating Officer submits that the verification with regard to the medical condition of petitioner's father was done from Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital and the factum of the petitioner's father being seriously ill has been verified and medical documents in this respect have been found genuine.

9. She further submits that in so far as the verification of documents from RML Hospital is concerned, where the petitioner's father was referred to by the Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital, are yet to be verified.

10. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner's father also suffers from mental ailment for which he has been undergoing treatment from the Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences (IHBAS) and the documents with regard to the same shall be shared by him with the Investigating Officer today itself.
